prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     If object is nearby, grab it, check its properties and perform task, then move to destination. Otherwise, approach or scan area.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <SubTree ID = PerformSpecificTask    /> <SubTree ID = MoveToDestination    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <SubTree ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO PerformSpecificTask
		DO MoveToDestination
	END
